build.beforeDevCommand: while [ ! -d apps/desktop/frontend ] && [ "$PWD" != / ]; do cd ..; done; cd apps/desktop/frontend && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: while [ ! -d apps/desktop/frontend ] && [ "$PWD" != / ]; do cd ..; done; cd apps/desktop/frontend && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-src 'none'
